articles.title: Revellers parade giant penises to dash stigma in Japan's fertility festival
articles.mainIdea: Revellers parade giant penises to dash stigma in Japan's fertility festival
articles.summary: AFP: Revellers parade giant penises to dash stigma in Japan's fertility festival. Showcasing phallus-shaped portable shrines and pink penis candies, Japan's annual fertility festival teemed Sunday with tourists, couples and families elated by its open display of sex.The open-minded, all-inclusive annual event attracts everyone from tourists to families with children and LGBTQ supporters sporting rainbow outfits.
